reviewer: flash_review independent local public source inspection

findings.evidence: Loop deadline is checked only before ping/connect. connect_legacy has separate connection/handshake/auth/identity waits and can return after end; successful return has no monotonic postcheck.
findings.minimum_fix: Bound only the owned connection attempt by remaining absolute 90 second acquisition budget, close owned attempt on expiry, and reject any result returned after end.

findings.evidence: read p s does not validate exactly two positive numeric fields before the process-ended test. Missing/malformed identity can fail the live test and be printed as M5_GUARD_ENDED, then permit RAM deletion.
findings.minimum_fix: Require exactly two positive integer PID/start values before testing process liveness or removing guard RAM.

findings.evidence: Unprotected c.close() is the first operation in finally. An exception there bypasses the AP restore/nft/RAM block and final receipt save.
findings.minimum_fix: Record/catch the owned M5 close error independently and always attempt AP closure and durable final result.

reviewed_positive_boundaries: TTL is set to 180 and the exact native guard literal +480 is replaced with +180.
Atomic owned bridge table is installed while AP is confirmed off; patched native restore verifies final radio-off before owner-bound nft deletion.
No IE/admitter/load/scan/CPE treatment is added; M5 reads compare original boot, config/protected hashes, network and open profile before cleanup.
Exact original owned M5 directory/source hash and nonsymlink fixed-file cleanup are retained.
arm failure does not delete nft unless helper.off verifies radio remains off; otherwise native guarded restore remains the fallback.
limits: Static local public review only. No radio, network, credentials, private data, builds or tests executed.
Findings are source failure-path/correctness defects; they are not claims that those failures occurred on hardware.
AA remains aborted and LBM5 restoration remains unknown; a future recovery success cannot rescue AA research acceptance.
